Time: 1pm — 4pm EST (12pm — 3pm Central Time / 10am — 1pm Pacific Time). 
Topics: 
• Creativity and society. Innovator vs consumer. 
• Creativity deconstructed. Building blocks of creativity. 
• Innovation, salience, and how they interact in the creative process. 
• Creativity and intelligence. Are they linked and when do they become uncoupled? 
• Creativity and psychopathology: Affective disorders, FTD, and other conditions. 
• Enhancing creativity? Creativity as the new focus of educational process. 
• Evolutionary roots of creativity. Defining and studying creativity in other species. 
• Creativity and artificial intelligence. 
November 28 (Tuesday) - Creativity and the Brain 
Time: 1pm — 4pm EST (12pm — 3pm Central Time / 10am — 1pm Pacific Time). 
Topics: 
• Facts and fads of creativity. No single locus in the brain. 
• Creativity, novelty, and the right hemisphere. 
• Salience, decision making, and the frontal lobes. 
• "Standing on the shoulders of giants" and the left hemisphere. 
• Perspiration and inspiration: hyperfrontality and hypofrontality. 
• Creativity and the genes: candidate genes and whole genome. 
• Group creativity: How different brains can work better together.

From: David Gelernter
To: Jeffrey Epstein <jeevacation@gmail.com> 
Subject: what I left out (1 page) 
Date: Mon, 25 Apr 2011 22:50:34 +0000 
Attachments: A-Lab Plan.doc 
This (below & attached, I page) is the actual plan of action that I described this AM on the phone. (Other stuff sent earlier = bios, past vs 
future.) 
David 
Plan. (a) Design and file patents on downloadable activity-stream builder and tuner [6 months). (b) Build prototype software [6 months]. 
(c) Release builder and tuner on the Web for download by a small but growing user community [3-6 months]. (d) Acquisition. 
The company (A-Lab) starts small (5 people) and never grows large (10 people max). 
Who uses our software? A growing number of individual users and organizations world-wide will want to generate their own narrative 
streams, here called filaments. Such filaments will be narratives, journals or "documentary histories" (beads on a string, growing at one 
end) consisting of data units of all sorts: text, messages, images, sound, video, 3D scans. I tell the story of my life by generating a 
filament: I download the filament-builder and feed it (in realtime, as it happens) each element of my life story. Filament elements marked 
"public" are visible to the world at large. 
IBM tells its story, Fox News, the WSJ, the NYSE, the local school and school system and take-out pizza place tell theirs. All filaments in 
the Cybersphere, merged in realtime, are the "worldstream." 
Who watches these streams?  As well as (or instead of) browsing the Web, (a) I watch a blend of my favorite filaments as they develop in 
realtime or (b) I watch a subset of the worldstream focused on topics of interest. For example, I watch (a) my friends' filaments, favorite 
news filaments and local government filaments, blended together, or (b) I watch every posting in the world that deals with de Kooning's 
paintings, new US or Israeli software patents or Eclectus parrots. To watch filaments, I download the filament-tuner and spec my stream—
which can be re-mixed at any point. 
Our new company (A-Lab) designs, develops and releases a prototype Filament-builder and Filament-tuner. The builder and tuner can be 
downloaded and used on any standard intemet platform. 
In the several months following first public release, a small but steadily-growing group of users downloads our software. A-Lab becomes 
an obvious acquisition target.

, Doug 
Jeffrey, 
I reviewed the layout and comments from our 4/14 conference call with Tom. Attached are two options for the 
living room layout. We will model this in 3D for your review, but I want to address the location before we do that. 
Option H2-1 is our recommended layout. 
• 
The pool has been relocated based on the survey. 
• 
The living room is centered on the pool. 
• 
There is not enough room between the living room and pool for the floating square stair, so added a 
stair connecting that area down to the north terraces. 
• 
To avoid having a "canyon" between the living room and office, we added a restroom below the west 
planter. We also added a storage room below the planter on the east side. 
Option H2-2 is just to show the impact of we add the floating stair. It puts the living room 8'-10' off center from 
the pool. 
Please let us know if you have a preference, and we will complete the 3d model of this area (will take about 1 
day once we have a direction).
